title: Expressing Dissatisfaction and Making Proposals
summary: Stating problems, discussing changes, and proposing alternatives.
whyItMatters: Constructive dissatisfaction describes the current problem, its effect, and a realistic improvement without attacking people.

mentalModel.title: Observation, effect, request
mentalModel.content: State what happens, how it affects the work, and what change you propose.

mentalModel.title: Keep criticism specific
mentalModel.content: Discuss a process or condition rather than making a general judgment about a person.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe the problem neutrally
ruleBlocks.content: Use Mir ist aufgefallen, dass or Für mich ist schwierig, dass with a concrete example.

ruleBlocks.title: Explain the consequence
ruleBlocks.content: Show what becomes slower, unclear, stressful, expensive, or unreliable.

ruleBlocks.title: Offer a feasible next step
ruleBlocks.content: Use Ich schlage vor, Wir könnten, or Wäre es möglich and invite a response.

tables.title: Constructive Change Toolkit
rows: Ich bin damit nicht ganz zufrieden, weil ...

examples.de: Mir ist aufgefallen, dass sich die Dienstpläne sehr oft ändern.
examples.en: I have noticed that the duty schedules change very often.

examples.de: Dadurch kann ich private Termine nur schwer planen.
examples.en: As a result, I can plan private appointments only with difficulty.

examples.de: Ich schlage vor, die Pläne mindestens zwei Wochen vorher zu bestätigen.
examples.en: I suggest confirming the schedules at least two weeks in advance.

commonMistakes.correct: Name the process, example, and effect.
commonMistakes.reason: Specific criticism can be investigated and improved.

commonMistakes.correct: Add one realistic proposal or question.
commonMistakes.reason: A proposal moves the conversation toward action.
